objects.name: Analytic 2231
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an ICS device presenting protocol identity attributes (for example vendor, product, model, or capability identifiers) that conflict with the identity and capabilities recorded for that network address/device in the authorized asset inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
